summary: This joint resolution disapproves a Department of Energy rule setting certification, labeling, and enforcement requirements for energy conservation standards on certain consumer products and commercial equipment, nullifying the rule so it has no force or effect.

scores.thoughts: This bill nullifies a rule that modified energy efficiency regulations for consumer products and industrial equipment. By nullifying a rule aimed at aligning reporting requirements with energy conservation standards and providing information for product classification, it indirectly impacts environmental protection by potentially hindering efforts to improve energy efficiency, which is a component of environmental policy.
